business_summary: Putnam Master Intermediate Income Trust is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by Putnam Investment Management, LLC. The fund is co-managed by Putnam Investments Limited. It invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. The fund invests in bonds of companies operating across diversified sectors. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Barclays Capital Government/Credit Bond Index. Putnam Master Intermediate Income Trust was formed on April 29, 1988 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Putnam Master Intermediate Income Trust는 Putnam Investment Management, LLC가 출시하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 채권 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Putnam Investments Limited가 공동 관리합니다. 미국 채권시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 다양한 부문에 걸쳐 운영되는 회사의 채권에 투자합니다. Barclays Capital Government/Credit Bond Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. Putnam Master Intermediate Income Trust는 1988년 4월 29일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
